days.title: Lower Valley Gorges and Nature
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Ponte Brolla
stops.detail: At Ponte Brolla the force of the River Maggia has cleft the rock, gouging out and polishing the gneiss.

stops.name: Valle del Salto
stops.detail: The itinerary «Valle del Salto» in Maggia leads on nice paths and represents no important differences in height.

stops.name: Gordevio
stops.detail: Plunge into the invigorating waters of the crystal-clear Maggia River, take a walk and listen to the sounds of the magical forest, or start a crackling little fire on a rocky plateau by the shore: days and nights in Gordevio are made for people who want to get close to nature.
